Coutinho–Baptista supplies general conditions and a tree conjecture, and Kirkland–Monterde–Plosker supplies abstract weighted twin criteria but not the computed Jacobi spectra and Pell arithmetic. Overlap with generic methods is acknowledged; no universal originality certificate is claimed.

value.rationale: The explicit normalized-Laplacian transfer decision on a natural infinite family of minimally connected two-hub quantum networks addresses the motivating source’s tree-state-transfer obstruction and distinguishes high-fidelity transport from perfect transport. The infinite Pell-thin exception set gives a genuinely arithmetic phase boundary; the result is neither a standard normalization rewrite of adjacency bistars nor an arbitrary tiny graph census.
